title: The Years That Count
seoTitle: The Years That Count | Faraz Ansari
description: On uncertainty, belonging, marriage, children, and the futures we imagine while life keeps changing around us.
deck: The future remains a possibility. The present is the part of life we are actually living.
heroAlt: An atmospheric illustrated path towards a distant horizon, representing uncertainty, belonging and an unfinished future.
heroCaption: The years we spend waiting are not outside the story. They are the story.
